s: A company has multiple AWS accounts that are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to store AWS account activity and query the data from a central location by using SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements?
o: Create an AWS CloudTrail trail in each account. Specify CloudTrail management events for the trail. Configure CloudTrail to send the events to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure CloudWatch crossaccount observability. Query the data in CloudWatch Logs Insights.

Use a delegated administrator account to create an AWS CloudTrail Lake data store. Specify CloudTrail management events for the data store. Enable the data store for all accounts tn the organization. Query the data in CloudTrail Lake.

Use a delegated administrator account to create an AWS CloudTrail trail. Specify CloudTrail management events for the trail. Enable the trail for all accounts in the organization. Keep all other settings as default. Query the CloudTrail data from the CloudTrail event history page.

Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy AWS CloudTrail Lake data stores in each account. Specify CloudTrail management events for the data stores. Keep all other settings as default. Query the data in CloudTrail Lake.

w.y: You need central storage of account activity across the organization plus SQL queries. CloudTrail Lake event data stores support SQL natively. An organization event data store, which a delegated administrator account can create, collects management events from every member account into one place.

o.A: CloudWatch Logs Insights uses its own query language rather than SQL, and building trails in every account is more work.
o.B: Correct: an organization CloudTrail Lake event data store created by a delegated admin centralizes events and is queried with SQL.
o.C: CloudTrail event history shows only 90 days of management events for each account and Region; it can't be queried with SQL.
o.D: A separate data store in each account isn't central; you would have to query each account on its own.

s: Understanding organization event data stores - AWS CloudTrail
